rows.ARS:
Orange-pink Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Sabine Bosman
rows.Origin:
Bred by G. Delbard (France, before 2009).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2009 as 'Sabine Bosman'.
Introduced in United States by Ludwig's Roses Phoenix in 2016 as 'Kissing'.
rows.Bloom: Orange-pink, cream reverse. None / no fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
